name: gardenerim-monorepo
description: Gardenerim CSS framework, official framework adapters, and documentation website.

scripts.bootstrap: npm --prefix packages/css ci && npm --prefix packages/vue ci && npm --prefix packages/react ci && npm --prefix packages/angularjs ci && npm --prefix packages/blazor ci
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:vue && npm run build:react && npm run build:angularjs && npm run build:blazor
scripts.check: npm run check:repository && npm run check:packages && npm run check:website && npm run verify:exports
scripts.check:packages: npm --prefix packages/css run check && npm --prefix packages/vue run check && npm --prefix packages/react run check && npm --prefix packages/angularjs run check && npm --prefix packages/blazor run check
scripts.check:website: node website/scripts/build-css-catalog.mjs && node website/scripts/build-localized-pages.mjs --check && node website/scripts/check.mjs && node website/scripts/check-coverage.mjs
scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/css test && npm --prefix packages/vue test && npm --prefix packages/react test && npm --prefix packages/angularjs test && npm --prefix packages/blazor test
scripts.release:verify: npm --prefix packages/css run release:verify && npm --prefix packages/vue run release:verify && npm --prefix packages/react run release:verify && npm --prefix packages/angularjs run release:verify && npm --prefix packages/blazor run release:verify && npm run check:website && npm run verify:exports
